hypothesis.proposition: The flat V3 mixed-binding surface should remain explicit unresolved non-executable state until token-preserving binding evidence exists; semantic program identity and epoch/version runtime-state identity should remain distinct.
hypothesis.strongest_counterhypothesis: A single global precedence/desugaring is sufficient and can safely collapse the V3 mixed bindings without changing intended semantics.

out_of_box_experiment.name: semantic-versus-runtime-epoch identity cross-control
design: same semantic identity + changed epoch/version -> semantic id stable, state instance id changes
same epoch/version + admitted semantic mutation -> semantic identity changes
out_of_box_experiment.interpretation: Supports a two-layer identity model; does not promote WP03.

implementation_delta.reason: Live swarm refresh showed current main already contains the stronger receipt-bound no-reparse bridge tools/claycode_wp03_frontend_artifact_bridge.py.

live_swarm_fusion.binding_reconciliation: V3 measured 17 fail-closed mixed bindings; explicit token-preserving binding evidence reduces these to 0. The replication lane tests only that the pre-explicit V3 form never receives guessed precedence.

independent_source_findings: DIALECT_REGISTRY_V3 has source-backed load_dialects(task)=... arity semantics but no explicit concrete parameter/return types.
DIALECT_REGISTRY_V3 has typed Verifiable.verify(receipt:ReceiptRef)->Verification, but the real calls are unqualified verify/1 and verify/5; exact target identity is therefore absent.

FRANK_REWARD_STATE_SUCCESSOR_V1 semantically uses derive_typed_reward_outcome_evidence/reward_state.update/reward_state.control but does not declare exact callable signatures matching the G9 frank_reward.* targets.
G9 EffectIntent and Delta are record types, but single-argument call forms do not establish positional constructor CallContracts.

external_primary_evidence.finding: func.call operands and result types must match the specified function type.
CallOpInterface and CallableOpInterface separate calls from resolvable callable semantics and expose argument/result types.
LLVM function types/signatures explicitly bind return and parameter types; call arguments must match the signature.
Explicit legality/partial conversion supports conservative staged lowering rather than guessing unsupported semantics.

architecture_delta.wp03: KEEP_V18; preserve unresolved binding until explicit token-preserving lowering; keep semantic identity separate from runtime epoch/version identity.
architecture_delta.wp04: Require exact source-backed callable signature plus distinct runtime binding/currentness identity before any execution admission.

next_falsifier: Obtain one independently authoritative exact production callable signature (exact target, arity, ordered concrete parameter types, explicit return/effect class) or add an explicit versioned callable-interface specification. Bind its semantic contract identity separately from runtime component/currentness identity and rerun the WP04 constraint graph with execution still forbidden.
rollback: All new research artifacts are append-only or draft-lane controls; no canonical semantic/runtime authority or Frank Harness behavior was promoted.
